calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT category
FROM dim_product
WHERE category LIKE '%Clean%'
ORDER BY category

SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_name = 'Hyvinkää'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND p.category = 'Cleaning & Household'

SELECT 
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_name = 'Hyvinkää'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND p.category = 'Cleaning & Household'

SELECT 
  SUM(units_sold) AS daily_report_units
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE store_id = 107
  AND business_date >= '2026-08-31'
  AND business_date <= '2026-09-27'

SELECT 
  r.reason_code, 
  COUNT(*) as return_count,
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) as units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_name = 'Hyvinkää'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND p.category = 'Cleaning & Household'
GROUP BY r.reason_code
ORDER BY units_returned DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as row_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.store_key = 12
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
  AND f.product_key IN (
    SELECT product_key FROM dim_product 
    WHERE category = 'Cleaning & Household' AND is_current = true
  )

SELECT 
  s.store_name,
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_name = 'Hyvinkää'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND p.category = 'Cleaning & Household'
GROUP BY s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
